exposure: exposure to prenatal and perinatal morbidity
cohort: 153 children, including 64 with tic disorders and 89 without tic disorders
finding: After adjusting for family history of tics, neonatal respiratory distress syndrome, body mass index, prenatal infection, and coexisting comorbid neuropsychiatric disturbances, tic disorders were associated with prenatal exposure to tobacco and cesarean section.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of tic disorders.
